name: descentsVanish_add_planes
summary: Induction on |p|. For p empty the descent is the integral of the source term (integral_sourceTerm_eq_zero). For |p| = l + 1: by density it suffices to treat polynomial data; the descent F to W' is spherical at w and, by Hecke transfer and adjointness, killed by a Hecke polynomial with a small root (the transfer factor is a unit); so F = 0 by the maximum principle (eq_zero_of_heckePolyOp_eq_zero) once F is bounded. Boundedness: F(g) = F(gamma g) for a rational gamma; split theta into ell = theta - theta o zeroTerm (the zero term along one plane) and the zero term. ell(omega(gamma g, h) f) is bounded uniformly in g and h by the decay estimate exists_norm_name_le with N = 0 (the definite side V has height 1 at every h; moderate growth and averaging over the translates along the frame k give its norm hypotheses; when the height of W' at g exceeds 2, a short isotropic vector xi at g and gamma with gamma xi = k (Witt) supply the short isotropic frame it requires), Y is bounded on the definite quotient, and the integral of the zero term vanishes by the induction hypothesis for l planes. No fundamental domain is used.

  refine (Θ.fixesLeft_lift _ ⟨γ, rfl⟩ g).symm.trans (sub_eq_zero.1 ((integral_sub
    (Θ.integrable_theta_mul Y.2 ..) (.of_bound (hY.rec (by simp; fun_prop)) _ b)).symm.trans ?_)) ▸
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const b
